gloss: to roll around laughing; to be in fits of laughter

definitions.gloss: to roll around laughing; to double up with laughter
definitions.explanation: To laugh so hard that one almost falls over or rolls about. Used for helpless, uncontrollable laughter, often in exaggeration rather than literally.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{笑|わら}い{転|ころ}げた。
examples.english: Everyone was in fits of laughter.
The children are rolling around on the floor laughing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧なものまね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おかしくて→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おなか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧{笑|わら}い{転|ころ}げた。
examples.english: My father's clumsy impression was so funny that the whole family doubled up with laughter.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh) + ⟦{転|ころ}げる→転げる：27884_korogeru⟧ (to roll, tumble). Intransitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おなか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧{笑|わら}い{転|ころ}げる: to hold one's sides and roll around laughing
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}して→流す：01968_nagasu⟧{笑|わら}い{転|ころ}げる: to laugh until one cries

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}する→爆笑する：26846_bakushousuru⟧: to burst out laughing — a sudden roar of laughter, often from a group
- ⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to laugh loudly — less vivid than {笑|わら}い{転|ころ}げる
